input: Submit my short film to a festival

gold.taskTitle: Submit My Short Film to a Festival
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to submit their short film to a film festival.

questions.title: Which specific festival are you submitting to?
questions.description: Identify the target festival by name to tailor the submission plan.

questions.title: What is the festival submission deadline?
questions.description: Establish the exact date by which the submission must be completed.

questions.title: Is your film fully finished and export-ready?
questions.description: Determine whether the film still needs editing, color grading, sound mixing, or other post-production work.

questions.title: Which platform does the festival use for submissions?
questions.description: Identify whether submissions go through FilmFreeway, Withoutabox, a festival website, or another channel.

questions.title: Do you already have an account on that platform?
questions.description: Check whether the user needs to register before starting the submission process.

questions.title: What supporting materials does the festival require?
questions.description: Clarify what the festival asks for beyond the film itself, such as a synopsis, director bio, stills, or poster.

questions.title: Is there a submission fee, and do you have it ready?
questions.description: Confirm whether a fee applies and whether the user has a payment method prepared.
